This is an implemented control inventory, not a test-run report.
Review on changed standards, mechanisms, evidence or coverage. The
[registry](control-registry.json) owns these mappings; [engineering](engineering.md)
owns mandatory wording and [charter](charter.md) owns principles.

Automatic controls run in the common lane. Runtime controls act in the live system;
their tests cover only the stated cases. Manual controls require the named review
or probe. Implementation and evidence links do not assert a current execution or pass.

## Mechanisms and coverage

### C-PORTABLE — Portable regression lane (automatic)

Portable source, adapter, SDK, record/persistence and viewer regressions using synthetic/real-component fixtures. Native engine behavior and actual player outcomes are separate lanes. The existing tools/check.py runner executes syntax, selected Ruff, Import Linter, document metadata/local links, governance structure and whitespace. Local --fast stops there with calendar-only warnings. Strict full/editorial/viewer/main-smoke profiles also render diagrams and enforce current-date governance. Full collects existing unittest cases through pinned pytest with four pytest-xdist processes, built-in work stealing and 20 slowest durations; component profiles run explicit consumer/boundary tests grouped by file; main-smoke runs fixed selected cases serially. Every behavioral profile runs the Node viewer suite; editorial omits behavioral/viewer tests. tools/ci.py owns the shared explicit scope/test manifest and chooses from complete native Git diffs and existing GitHub PR/run/job facts under docs/project-management.md#protected-ci-profiles; unknown/nonregular eligibility selects full. docs/testing.md maps responsibilities, useful overlap and duplication review. Worker/check failures propagate without restart, ignored failures or cached green results. Focused development tests remain selected by the lead. Portable fixtures do not qualify gameplay or browser layout. Native pytest strict marker registration rejects undeclared metadata; the representative assurance groups in docs/testing.md support navigation/focused development, not production profile routing or semantic-coverage claims.

Owner: maintainer. Trigger: Fast structural checks on each configured local commit; focused tests on affected behavior; appropriate strict profile at coherent integration/formal acceptance and main-targeting PR/main CI events; broad source changes require full regression before merge.
Enforcement: Opt-in project-local pre-commit hook runs --fast. The always-present Actions controller selects a strict profile for PRs explicitly targeting main and pushes to main; no workflow path filters or ignored failures. Logs/Actions summary state profile/reason and qualifying PR coverage for main-smoke. Covered documentation and explicit viewer boundaries receive their declared strict scopes; cross-cutting, validation and unknown PR changes receive full. Changed validation machinery/context also forces full on main. GitHub concurrency cancels superseded PR runs only. Main retains strict Actions-app15368 controller requirement under ruleset25346774. Hooks remain bypassable. Hosted activation evidence must be recorded in the issue/PR after actual execution; this definition is not a hosted pass.
Failure response: Preserve failure output, fix the cause and rerun before claiming portable acceptance.

Coverage gap: Fast mode omits behavioral tests, viewer regressions and rendered diagrams. Editorial omits runtime/viewer tests; viewer covers explicit consumers and boundary smoke rather than full regression or browser layout; main-smoke does not rerun full regression and depends on qualifying linked PR coverage. Reduced scopes are not full portable passes. Focused selection and prose truth require judgment. Synthetic fixtures do not execute CDDA or prove host schema/image loading, review-free gameplay, fresh context, cross-game support or useful cadence. Link checks validate current Markdown fragments, but omit historical-origin fragment targets, external availability and raw HTML; Ruff is a selected diagnostic set, not full typing/formatting. Missing tools or denied loopback/browser access fail the affected lane. A started/cancelled check is not a pass.

### C-RUNTIME — Live authority and input guards (runtime)

Sole mechanical computer writer, original operation/resource custody, immutable images, bounded permanent Stop and actor-only succession; optional player services remain fallible. One current socket/SQLite contract, authenticated actor ingress, complete preflight and retained original IDs/ACK uncertainty. No game-phase or image-equality eligibility for keys. Pointer geometry and source bytes are checked mechanically. Pause bypasses player/executor/store waits. Current sealed actors may cancel; retired actors cannot stop successors. Quiescence requires actual owned host/MCP absence under original limits. Player knowledge/programs cannot grant authority; local refusal leaves basic input available.

Owner: controller and viewer maintainer. Trigger: every relevant request, observation and image decode.
Enforcement: Implemented at runtime; regression execution is C-PORTABLE. Source references alone establish no behavioral pass.
Failure response: Reject or permanently freeze further dispatch as applicable; collect original results, preserve uncertainty and perform owned cleanup. Any later play requires a fresh admission, never restored authority.

### C-NATIVE — Native build and real-game acceptance (manual)

Changed native/input/rendering/protocol/compiler/source-pin behavior and new support claims. Follow native acceptance probes, inspect actual game/spectator frames and record dated outcomes, environment, candidate and hashes.

Owner: integration maintainer; lead verifies evidence. Trigger: relevant native boundary change or new native release/support claim.
Enforcement: Required by S-PROTOCOL/S-DELIVERY and release review; manual, outside the portable gate. Permission readiness before ordinary campaign input also requires S-OPS's [live permission preflight](operator-permissions.md#preflight-for-every-campaign) from the actual designated player and exact entry point. Retain enabled project-layer evidence, rule decisions and live results separately. Repeated per-action review fails permission readiness even if every request is approved; resolve it before ordinary play. This is a manual activation check; prefix matching does not prove runtime loading.
Failure response: Retain failed/unknown probes, block the affected claim and repair or document the supported limit.

### C-RELEASE — Exact candidate and evidence review (manual)

Development checkpoint provenance and formal acceptance/release source identity and validation lanes. Inspect staged diff and public identity before each checkpoint; fast structural and applicable focused tests support a frozen finite development run. Before formal acceptance/merge, resolve independent review, verify appropriate exact PR/main CI under docs/project-management.md#protected-ci-profiles, full regression before merge for broad source changes, pins/exceptions and relevant native/graphical outcomes. A complete unchanged development run may supply prospective functional evidence after qualification, without becoming held-out data. Git owns source identity: commit before each native run, use commit/tree/diff/PR and hash external artifacts rather than building source history.

Owner: lead or releasing maintainer. Trigger: Development source checkpoint; comprehensive qualification at integrated acceptance, merge, release or new support claim.
Enforcement: Main requires a PR, the Actions-bound controller check and resolved conversations; no force-push/deletion or configured bypass. Lead still owns native/release acceptance. Zero required human approvals is an explicit single-account limit; agent review is not human approval.
Failure response: Block affected development on applicable authority/identity/Pause/budget/delivery/migration/cleanup failures. Hold formal acceptance/release until required failed or unexecuted lanes are resolved; preserve original outcomes and limits. Pending unrelated full CI is not an automatic development gate.

### C-MAINTENANCE — Drift, recovery and retention review (manual)

Active guidance, dependency/research freshness, failure evidence and project-owned cleanup. At behavior/control failure, release, resumption or the recorded due date, reassess the affected current guidance, mechanism, evidence and cost under S-CODE/S-OPS/S-DOCS/S-EVIDENCE. Use the existing Issue and registry record to keep, strengthen, simplify, replace or retire the control; preserve historical failures and unknown labor. Promote a demonstrated recurrence into an appropriate boundary regression or real-game assessment. Compare useful gameplay reached with available setup/check/review/rework burden, and separate API estimates/invoices/unknown usage from conservative reservations. Revisit duplicate private tooling and documentary inventories; use maintained entry points and authoritative evidence families. C-GOVERNANCE detects structural/due-date faults when invoked; review quality and semantic detection remain manual.

Owner: maintainer; lead tracks active work. Trigger: behavior/control failure, release, resumed work or active-development review interval.
Enforcement: Manual event-triggered review under S-OPS/S-AGENT/S-DOCS/S-EVIDENCE; C-GOVERNANCE checks registry structure and dates. Fast warnings do not postpone applicable incident/resumption/change/release review or permit work across actual failures/evidence gaps. Resolve overdue review at the existing integration/formal-acceptance checkpoint; every strict CI profile enforces current-date governance.
Failure response: Record the owner and action in the existing Issue, repair guidance and preserve failures. Retire saves only through owned archive/hash verification and applicable authorization in the runbook; cleanup is not normal game completion.

### C-VISUAL — Rendered visual documentation (automatic)

Mermaid sources and generated SVGs in docs/diagrams. Pinned local Mermaid CLI renders every source in a headless project-local browser. Hash receipt covers sources, config, wrapper, package lock and tracked SVGs; title/description and root SVG ID are required. Explicit --write regenerates; normal checks leave tracked files unchanged.

Owner: documentation maintainer. Trigger: common command; source, renderer configuration or dependency changes require rendered review.
Enforcement: Common command fails on renderer errors, missing title/description/ID or changed input/output receipts; negative fixtures include a real parse failure. No global installation or automatic fetch.
Failure response: Fix syntax or missing setup; regenerate stale output and inspect the rendered result. Never call a denied browser launch a passed check. Resolve semantic/readability findings through C-USABILITY/C-REVIEW.

Evidence / implementation: [tools/diagrams.py](../tools/diagrams.py), [tests/test_diagrams.py](../tests/test_diagrams.py), [docs/diagrams/rendered.json](../docs/diagrams/rendered.json), [docs/architecture.md](../docs/architecture.md), [docs/overview.md](../docs/overview.md), [package.json](../package.json), [package-lock.json](../package-lock.json), [.puppeteerrc.cjs](../.puppeteerrc.cjs), [docs/decisions/004-documentation-controls.md](../docs/decisions/004-documentation-controls.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-public-workflow.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-public-workflow.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-public-recovery-evaluation.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-public-recovery-evaluation.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-passive-supervisor.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-passive-supervisor.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-18-integrated-player.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-18-integrated-player.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-18-walk-reassessment.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-18-walk-reassessment.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-27-audit-resolution.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-27-audit-resolution.md), [docs/diagrams/binding-projections.mmd](../docs/diagrams/binding-projections.mmd), [docs/diagrams/campaign-custody.mmd](../docs/diagrams/campaign-custody.mmd).

## Interpreting results

Run `.venv/bin/python tools/check.py` for the portable lane; update this map with
`.venv/bin/python tools/governance.py --write`. The latter validates before writing and
does not run gameplay. Dated executions belong in [acceptance](acceptance/2026-10-17-mvp.md)
and [work](work.md), with exact candidate, failures and unexecuted lanes.
